newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela names new labor, environment ministers.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela names new labor, environment ministers.

text.p: Venezuelan President Rafael Caldera nominated new labour and environment ministers on Thursday in a cabinet shakeup following the resignation of two top officials last week.
Maria Bernadoni de Gobea was promoted from vice labour minister to take over from Juan Nepomuceno Garrido, who was approved as attorney general by Congress earlier in the day.
Caldera proposed Garrido last week after Jesus Petit da Costa resigned as attorney general in protest over alleged lack of cooperation from top government officials.
Rafael Martinez Monroe, previously president of the state water company Hidoven, was named as environment minister to replace Roberto Perez Lecuna who also resigned last week.
